meta.problem: The radio station KMDX is donating dog food to help a local pet shelter. The people at the radio station offered to give the shelter 2 small bags of dog food for every 7 cans of pet food that are donated to the shelter. If the radio station has given the shelter a total of 8 small bags of dog food, how many cans of pet food have been donated to the shelter?
